title: Sludge to Silicon: The Last Upgrade
summary: Amidst jaggy trumpets and frosty sludge, a lone teenager, a version of a forgotten dairyman, grapples with a carjacked relic. Her networking skills are poor, a dentist's nightmare, but she offloads her gear, ignoring the vitriolic juveniles. Lastly, an eyebrow twitches. Hired to recover ancient originals during a gassed cataclysm, she's overloaded and bruised. A pyromaniac's triangle glows on her compass. As horny hackers unleash an unheard, unholy fuss, she must upgrade useless silicon, pronouncing a code for greatness amidst the warzone's whammy. Visibly chuffed, she navigates the earthed, rundown landscape, her loyalty undoing old bondage, stopping the killing and blabber, creating chummy jobs and empathy, a master of peace.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
